featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新建 NSH 项目固定使用官方 0.5.0，自动安装同版本编码与设计 Skills。桌面、移动、Web 和 TUI 共用 Mixed TSX 与 Rust core。
featureOptimizations.en-US: New NSH projects pin official 0.5.0 and install the matching coding and design skills. Desktop, mobile, web, and TUI share Mixed TSX and the Rust core.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 桌面使用官方多窗口、托盘、单实例和深链接，初始化按能力依赖询问并核对所选目标的运行证据。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Desktop uses official multi-window, tray, single-instance, and deep-link support. Initialization asks about capabilities in dependency order and checks runtime evidence for the selected targets.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 桌面、移动和 Web 统一使用官方打包器，支持 Android APK/AAB、iOS 模拟器包和显式签名 IPA。TUI 通过官方命令运行和测试。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Desktop, mobile, and web use the official packager, including Android APK/AAB, iOS simulator apps, and explicitly signed IPA. TUI uses the official run and test commands.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 移除旧 GPUI 与独立 TUI 工程入口。已有项目的旧配置需要在原项目中迁移。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Removed the legacy GPUI and standalone TUI workflows. Existing projects with those configurations require migration in their own repositories.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 NSH 组合项目打包时的资源路径丢失、iOS 模拟器开发目标和交叉编译 SDK 头文件解析。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed lost resource paths when packaging combined NSH projects, the iOS simulator development target, and SDK header resolution during cross-compilation.

bugFixes.zh-CN: NSH 接线失败后可安全重试，回滚仅清理本次生成的内容并保留并发写入。
bugFixes.en-US: NSH adapter setup can be retried after a failure. Rollback removes files created by that attempt and preserves concurrent writes.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: Desktop 统一使用 Tauri。选择 Desktop 后直接进入桌面配置，GPUI 工具链、脚手架、Skills、构建和验收入口已移除。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Desktop now uses Tauri. Selecting Desktop opens its configuration directly. The GPUI toolchain, scaffolding, Skills, build and verification entry points have been removed.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 创建指南集中说明环境检查、中性初始化、接口裁剪与独立 Git 基线的顺序，并给出 NSH 的对应步骤。
featureOptimizations.en-US: The project creation guide documents the sequence for environment checks, neutral initialization, interface pruning and the independent Git baseline, with the corresponding NSH steps.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复切换到 CLI 或 MCP 后旧桌面答案误触发 NSH 问询的问题。项目准备现在使用表单确认的规范路径，并拒绝目标在确认后被重定向。
bugFixes.en-US: Fixed stale Desktop answers triggering NSH questions after switching to CLI or MCP. Project preparation now uses the confirmed canonical path and rejects redirection after confirmation.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 升级候选会拒绝上游专用入口与退役资产。显式使用 GPUI 的旧项目须先单独处理，再升级到本版。
bugFixes.en-US: Upgrade candidates reject upstream-only entry points and retired assets. Existing projects that explicitly use GPUI require separate handling before upgrading to this version.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: NSH 桌面模板的设置、关于和赞助页面采用统一布局与双语状态反馈。
featureOptimizations.en-US: NSH desktop templates now use consistent layouts and bilingual state feedback for Settings, About, and Sponsor pages.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: NSH 移动模板加入固定底部导航、安全区域留白与状态栏外观同步。
featureOptimizations.en-US: NSH mobile templates now provide fixed bottom navigation, safe area spacing, and matching status bar appearance.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 暂停与正式工具链不兼容的 TUI 预览目标，并统一 NSH 0.4.0 CLI 与 Cargo 依赖。
bugFixes.en-US: Paused the TUI preview target that conflicted with the formal toolchain and aligned NSH 0.4.0 CLI and Cargo dependencies.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐移动候选的 Device Hub 与模拟器交互检查，避免误判无法验证。
bugFixes.en-US: Added Device Hub and simulator interaction checks for mobile candidates to avoid incorrectly marking them untestable.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增固定官方 main 提交的 NSH TUI 预览目标，支持终端运行、测试和本机预览归档。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add an NSH TUI preview target pinned to an official main commit, with terminal run, test, and local preview archive workflows.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新项目初始化逐项提问并用可点击选项确认多选；CLI、MCP、DESKTOP 默认声明 Windows/macOS/Linux 全平台。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Ask new-project setup questions one field at a time and confirm multiple selections through clickable options; CLI, MCP, and DESKTOP declare Windows, macOS, and Linux by default.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 改进 NSH 桌面侧栏的导航层级、键盘焦点和亮暗主题反馈。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Improve NSH desktop sidebar hierarchy, keyboard focus, and light and dark theme feedback.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 发布后本地打包按当前宿主解析唯一候选目标，NSH 产物按目标批次保存并核验。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Resolve one local package target for the current host after release, and store and verify NSH artifacts in separate target batches.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 明确 Tauri、GPUI 与 NSH 各自适用的工程和验证规则，并增加 Markdown 本地章节链接校验。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Clarify the engineering and verification rules for Tauri, GPUI, and NSH, and validate local Markdown section links.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 NSH 初始化重复询问系统平台和 NSH 能力的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix the duplicate system-platform and NSH capability questions during NSH setup.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复无本机正式候选时仍可选择本地打包、导致发布后路由为空的问题。
bugFixes.en-US: Prevent local packaging from being selected when the current host has no supported release target.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 同步 NSH 桌面能力问询、Skill 与设计标准，明确不可用能力由限制规则关闭。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Align NSH desktop capability questions, the Skill, and design guidance, with unavailable capabilities disabled by the capability rules.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 深链接先在原生宿主排队，再由 TSX 主动领取；关窗后转交未领取链接，避免启动阶段或窗口关闭时丢失。
bugFixes.en-US: Queue deep links in the native host for the TSX UI to claim and transfer unclaimed links after a window closes, preventing lost links during startup and window closure.

bugFixes.zh-CN: macOS 单实例 IPC 重试复用请求 ID 并去重，避免同一深链接重复交付。
bugFixes.en-US: Reuse and deduplicate macOS single-instance IPC request IDs across retries so the same deep link is delivered only once.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Linux 托盘关窗回调的借用冲突，并以原子替换注册深链接入口，避免覆盖符号链接指向的文件。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix Linux tray close-callback borrowing and atomically replace the deep-link desktop entry to avoid overwriting a symlink target.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 将 NSH 设为独立程序类型，桌面、移动和 Web 新工程统一采用 TSX 界面与共享 Rust 核心的 Mixed 模式。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Make NSH an independent project type and use a Mixed TSX interface with a shared Rust core for new desktop, mobile, and Web projects.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 桌面生成对应平台的原生宿主，默认支持多窗口，并按选择接入托盘、自启、单实例和深链接。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Generate platform-native desktop hosts with multi-window support by default and opt-in tray, autostart, single-instance, and deep-link wiring.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 整理 Skills、流程和知识索引，按所选接口裁剪无关能力；固定 NSH 0.4.0 的 TUI 目标继续失败关闭。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Align Skills, workflows, and knowledge indexes, prune capabilities outside the selected interface, and keep the NSH 0.4.0 TUI target fail-closed.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 macOS 无托盘时关闭最后窗口后进程仍驻留的问题，并保留启用托盘时的关窗恢复行为。
bugFixes.en-US: Exit the macOS process after its last window closes without a tray while preserving close-and-restore behavior when the tray is enabled.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 桌面窗口列表按各窗口当前语言更新标题，设置页切语言后菜单同步变化；紧凑侧栏英文标签不再换行。
bugFixes.en-US: Update desktop window lists to use each window’s current language, refresh menus after language changes in Settings, and keep English compact-sidebar labels on one line.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复 Linux 自启状态误报，拒绝会生成无效桌面入口的深链接路径。
bugFixes.en-US: Fix incorrect Linux autostart status and reject deep-link paths that would produce invalid desktop entries.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 补齐 macOS 深链接 URL 角色声明；组合工程的移动和 Web 包移除桌面专用宿主权限。
bugFixes.en-US: Complete the macOS deep-link URL role declaration and remove desktop-only host permissions from mobile and Web packages in combined projects.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 完善 NSH 初始化接线、侧栏与双语关于页，发布日志可在应用内展开查看。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Complete NSH initialization wiring, sidebar behavior, and the bilingual About page with expandable in-app release notes.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 接入 NSH 独立候选打包与最终产物证据；中性 macOS 和 Web 工程通过真实构建与界面 E2E。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add independent NSH candidate packaging and final artifact evidence; a neutral macOS and Web project passed real builds and UI E2E.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 移除新项目的 TUI 初始化选项和专用技能；既有 TUI 下游资产仍受保护，升级前需单独迁移。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Remove TUI initialization and its dedicated skill for new projects; existing TUI downstream assets remain protected and require a separate migration before upgrade.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 修复较大发布日志触发进程环境变量长度限制的问题，并排除生成的 .nsh 缓存。
bugFixes.en-US: Avoid process environment limits with large release notes and exclude generated .nsh caches.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 纠正 iOS 本地 .app 与正式 IPA 的打包边界，避免将未签名试包误判为渠道产物。
bugFixes.en-US: Clarify the boundary between local iOS .app packages and formal IPA distribution so unsigned trial packages are not treated as channel artifacts.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增确认摘要绑定的工程层准备与终端裁剪，固定复制清单并重置身份和策略，保护许可证及第三方资产。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add confirmation-bound engineering preparation and terminal pruning with fixed copy manifests, identity and policy reset, and license and vendor protection.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 治理文档检查保留稳定引用与命令约束，减少等义措辞改写造成的误报。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Keep stable references and command contracts in governance checks while reducing false failures from equivalent wording changes.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 裁剪保留未知文件，修复身份串联替换、成员版本不一致及清理失败后的恢复状态。
bugFixes.en-US: Preserve unknown files during pruning and fix cascading identity replacement, member version drift, and recovery states after cleanup failures.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Windows 开发循环改用持续持有的 Job 管理后代进程，补齐控制中断与输出收尾；原生宿主验证仍待完成。
bugFixes.en-US: Manage Windows development descendants through persistent Job ownership with control cancellation and output cleanup; native-host verification remains pending.

bugFixes.zh-CN: Linux 本地 deb 与侧车证据整组提交，增加流式摘要、超时和取消清理；原生 dpkg 验证仍待完成。
bugFixes.en-US: Commit Linux local deb packages and sidecar evidence as one collection with streaming hashes, timeouts, and cancellation cleanup; native dpkg verification remains pending.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 统一 NSH GUI 本地打包的策略说明与初始化表单条件。
bugFixes.en-US: Align NSH GUI local-packaging policy descriptions with initialization-form conditions.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 NSH 第三框架，按平台能力完成桌面、Android、iOS、Web 初始化及共享 Rust core 接线。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add NSH alongside Tauri and GPUI, with platform-aware initialization and shared Rust core wiring for desktop, Android, iOS and Web.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 新增 NSH 本地与候选打包、版本同步、发布元数据及按框架裁剪的升级支持。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Add dedicated NSH local and candidate packaging, version synchronization, release metadata, and framework-specific upgrade pruning.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 处理 iOS 可执行文件与资源目录重名，生成同时兼容 Android 和 Apple 的应用标识。
bugFixes.en-US: Prevent iOS executable and resource name collisions, and generate application identifiers accepted by both Android and Apple.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 在写入工作区前格式化生成的 Rust，并补齐框架元数据的 NSH 文档声明。
bugFixes.en-US: Format generated Rust before writing the workspace and include NSH in the documented GUI framework values.

featureOptimizations.zh-CN: 下游升级首次确认并记忆退役工程资产的清理或保留选择。
featureOptimizations.en-US: Remember each downstream project’s confirmed choice to remove or preserve retired engineering assets.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 发现旧来源锁未登记的退役文件；清理未完成时拒绝记录升级完成。
bugFixes.en-US: Detect retired files absent from legacy source locks and prevent upgrades from being recorded as complete before cleanup finishes.

bugFixes.zh-CN: 清除退役更新、统计执行合同和远程追踪依赖候选，保留历史验证事实。
bugFixes.en-US: Remove retired update and statistics execution contracts and remote tracing dependency candidates while preserving historical verification facts.
